title: Date and Time Format Handling
query: Schedule a meeting for tomorrow at 2:30 PM

datetime.description: Meeting date and time in ISO 8601 format (e.g., '2024-03-15T14:30:00Z')

explanation: Date/time format must match the schema requirement: ISO 8601 format. Convert '2:30 PM' to 24-hour format '14:30', and 'tomorrow' to actual date (assuming today is March 15, 2024). Format: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ. The 'T' separates date and time, 'Z' indicates UTC timezone. Note: In real systems, you'd need current date context. Here we demonstrate format understanding.
learning_points: Relative dates ('tomorrow') need conversion to absolute dates
'T' separates date and time in ISO format
'Z' suffix indicates UTC (can also use +HH:MM for timezones)
